name: RH5DG2
summary: RH5DG2 is INSPIRE ROBOTS' higher-dexterity five-finger hand with 13 controlled degrees of freedom and 18 joints. The manufacturer combines eight tactile sensors with force, position and temperature feedback, and lists a mass of 990 ±10 g. Index and middle finger lateral movement supports a wider range of grasp configurations. EtherCAT is paired with CAN FD or RS485 according to the selected model. The official table distinguishes thumb and other-finger gripping force from an 8 kg passive fingertip load; the passive load is not an active lifting specification.
